info.title: ingest-shim
info.summary: Authenticated, scope-guarded HTTPS front door that republishes SparkPlug JSON envelopes to RabbitMQ.
info.description:
Accepts one SparkPlug-derived JSON envelope per request from a client's Node-RED tee, checks the shared `X-Ingest-Key`, admits only envelopes whose group (first topic segment) equals the configured scope (SCOPE_GROUP, default `INCOPLAST`), and publishes it to RabbitMQ with publisher confirms. The envelope is republished once per configured flow (FANOUT_SOURCE_TYPES, default `legacy,go,refactored` -> `source_type` "", "go", "refactored"); a failure on any copy returns 503 so the tee retries the whole message (all downstream writers are idempotent).

Transport: the listener is TLS-only (`ListenAndServeTLS`, HTTP_ADDR default `:8444`), with the certificate mounted at /certs. Prometheus metrics are on a separate plaintext listener (METRICS_ADDR, default `:9105`).

Public exposure: none. No nginx vhost routes to this service on staging or production. Staging publishes the port on the host loopback only (127.0.0.1:8444). Production defines the service behind the `client-ingest` compose profile and publishes 8444 on all host interfaces, but the production security group does not admit 8444. The servers below are in-network addresses.

Ops route not described here: `GET /healthz` (200 `{"status":"ok"}`, or 503 `{"status":"amqp_down"}`).

servers.description: In-network on packiot-net (staging and production: static IP 172.18.0.29:8444). TLS with the stack's mounted certificate.
Local development (`make dev SVC=ingest-shim`; self-signed dev cert, use curl -k)

post.description: Order of checks: API key (401) -> body read under MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 1 MiB; over the cap, unreadable or empty -> 400) -> group extraction (400 when the body is not a JSON object or carries no topic/group) -> scope check (403) -> fan-out publish (503 on any broker failure). The body is otherwise forwarded verbatim, with a top-level `source_type` added per copy.

202.description: Every fan-out copy was confirmed by the broker.

400.description: `payload too large`, `cannot read body`, `empty body`, `unparseable or topicless payload`, or `unparseable payload (fanout)`.

403.description: `out-of-scope group`: the envelope's group is not the configured scope group.

503.description: `publish failed`: the broker did not confirm a copy. Retry the whole message.

ingestKey.name: X-Ingest-Key
ingestKey.description: Shared ingest key (INGEST_API_KEY), compared in constant time. Never logged.

SparkplugEnvelope.description: A JSON object from the tee. The shim reads only the fields below to find the group (first `/`-separated segment, tried in order: `topic`, `group`, `group_id`, then each `metrics[].name`); all other fields pass through untouched to the downstream worker. Any existing top-level `source_type` is overwritten per fan-out copy.
